old_problem: The prior AI dropped the Master firmware-write step, while the source's bare container workflow lacked immutable artifact, component allowlist, compatibility, activation and recovery details.
disposition_reason: ED-07 requires approved flash coverage and before/after verification to remain. Exact container and platform mappings are safe runtime prerequisites under ED-03, provided the write is separately authorized and cannot begin without recovery readiness.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row350 all 18 XLSX columns and history2946.
Preserved container selection, pre-version inventory, actual update, activation and post-version validation.
No firmware command, reboot or DUT operation occurred.

test_case.test_name: NVSM signed firmware-container update with per-component verification
test_case.purpose: Apply one approved immutable NVSM firmware container only to its allowlisted components and prove intended active versions plus platform health across activation.
required_package: Pinned NVSM build and vendor-supported update syntax
Signed container with immutable hash and release notes
Stable redundant power, OOB console and maintenance authorization
test_case.test_command: Inventory firmware and health without clearing logs; after separate flash authorization, validate container signature/hash and target allowlist, run the exact approved NVSM update once, perform the specified activation/reboot, then re-inventory every target and validate device/service health.
test_case.expected_result: Only allowlisted components transition from recorded current versions to approved active versions, update/activation complete without error, and all platform services, GPUs, PCIe links, BMC, thermal and power health remain within the signed oracle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable artifact-to-target traceability, the approved active version after activation and complete health evidence; read-only inventory or command success alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Independent flash authorization after all prechecks
Exact target allowlist and signature/hash match
Stable redundant power and verified OOB recovery
Preserve logs; stop on any unexpected target/version/health event; no automatic retry
expected_evidence: Rollback readiness or controlled recovery record
test_case.recovery: On a failed or partial update, do not retry; maintain power, use the approved OOB/vendor recovery route, restore the documented compatible image/bank if authorized, and preserve all evidence.

source_conflict.reason: Master intent is internally consistent; the defect was DeepSeek's omission of the update step.
